## Privacy and release impact

- [ ] Selected text remains local to the machine.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, model weights, generated runtimes, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Dependency and release-lock changes are intentional and hash-pinned where required.
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated when behavior changed.
